network_status.network: Bridge collapses in Italy across the 21st century: survey and statistical analysis
network_status.summary_it: Le fonti documentano il danneggiamento del ponte per Ovedasso durante le piogge del 13 agosto 2014 e l'erosione presso la pila centrale, ma non pubblicano livello, portata o idrogramma dell'Aupa. Il processo resta documentato senza falsa precisione idrometrica.
network_status.summary_en: The sources document damage to the Ovedasso bridge during rainfall on 13 August 2014 and erosion at the central pier but publish no Aupa stage, discharge or hydrograph. The process remains documented without false hydrometric precision.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
